newsitem.title: USA: Cushman & Wakefield to buy company from Prudential.
newsitem.headline: Cushman & Wakefield to buy company from Prudential.

text.p: Cushman & Wakefield, a leading international real estate services firm, said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Premisys Real Estate Services Inc. from Prudential Insurance Co. of America.
Terms of the proposed deal were not disclosed.
New York-based Cushman said that, when completed, the transaction will increase its real estate management portfolio by about 30 percent, to more than 200 million square feet worldwide.
Premisys, a Houston-based property management and leasing services firm, has a nationwide portfolio of 65 million square feet of office, industrial and residential properties.

The properties include those held in Prudential's $5.5 billion so-called general account on behalf of policyholders, as well as many of Prudential's own corporate facilities and properties owned by third parties.
